review_scope: All 293 NEW lightweight prose/metadata blocks scanned; focused exact pinned-source checks for feature attribution, guards/defaults, validation categories, inference labels and documented manual procedures. No knowledge generation, model calls, campaign changes or WT edits. Protected strict207 preserved. This is a content review and does not grant release/merge approval.

category_contract.rule: helper_unit checks a helper rather than production integration; reject an overstated category

rejections.reason: The title/body promise that any exception inside the try becomes FAILED. The implementation catches Exception, which excludes asyncio.CancelledError. A read-only replay of the actual execute AST with a transport raising CancelledError propagated cancellation, enqueued only WORKING, and still cleared pending state/closed the queue; it did not emit FAILED. The blanket failure guarantee is unsupported.

The cited _finalize_external_memory_session flushes and commits ExternalMemoryRail session messages via provider.on_session_end. It does not describe context-summary or tool-result offload dependencies; unloading an external memory rail is distinct from context compression/offload. This decision excludes only the new lightweight block and does not reinterpret the protected strict baseline.

The cited branch is _reload_session_adapter_if_stale permission-policy reload: permission delta, smart lifecycle, external CHAT_SEND, deferred permission reload and cancellation eviction. It does not handle context compression, summary construction or tool-result offload failures.

The current validation_kind is automated_runtime, but the cited test only stubs the configuration loader and calls the resolve_debug_trace_settings helper to assert a returned field. It does not exercise logger, stream or tracing integration. Under the current helper-versus-production-integration category contract, the evidence is helper_unit; retaining the frozen raw block would overstate the category.

The current validation_kind is automated_runtime, but the cited test only calls the pure reconcile_builtin_models helper on dict/list fixtures and asserts its return values. It exercises no native CLI harness, probe, authentication, refresh or persistence integration. Under the current helper-versus-production-integration category contract, this is helper_unit; retaining the frozen raw block would overstate the category.

The cited sessionInput test checks ordinary queued chat receipt cleanup after clearMessages and late chat.error. It contains no command.goal, goal snapshot/update, objective, or goal-mode state assertion. This does not establish goal-mode validation.

The cited fail/outcome methods belong to generic _TurnOutcomeTracker. Its waiting_user flag is set by ordinary chat.ask_user_question, with no human seat, HITT, join, member identity or team-message routing. This cannot establish the flow of human members participating in an AgentTeam.

The cited helpers are tested only with model_type='vision' and VISION_ENABLED. Their supported model types are audio/vision/video, explicitly excluding image_gen. Image generation instead uses apply_image_gen_model_config_from_yaml and _invoke_model_image_generation. These tests cannot count as image-generation helper validation.

The cited truth-table test exercises memory.engine helpers for MemoryRail and ExternalMemoryRail. TaskMemory experience tools use a separate task_memory.enabled gate and TaskMemoryService initialization. No cited assertion calls or checks that task-memory implementation.

The cited _validate_extractor validates EternalConversation snapshots and changed_uts, not TTSE FACT/TIP evolution. TTSERail and EternalConversationRail are separate implementations and builders. Accurate local prose from the wrong feature cannot establish TTSE failure coverage.
